subject.title: fix(mcp): timeout flags treat hexadecimal input as seconds

question: Should MCP timeout flags intentionally stop accepting non-decimal prefixed numeric tokens that current releases accept?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but tightening an already accepted CLI input syntax is an upgrade-compatibility choice that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt strict decimal grammar
options.body: Merge the common-boundary validation and require affected scripts to use decimal or scientific notation.

options.title: Preserve a transition path
options.body: Temporarily retain the old tokens with an explicit deprecation warning and remove them in a later planned compatibility change.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict decimal grammar
recommendation.body: Merge the common-boundary validation and require affected scripts to use decimal or scientific notation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current MCP CLI timeout helper and both affected command paths.
